action.name: Active HyperBoost and Balanced thermal-mode readback
action.value: Two exact thermal-channel getters after bounded forced Synapse termination in each operator-confirmed state

sanitizedEvidence.summary: With Synapse visibly in HyperBoost, its application process was force-terminated before normal shutdown cleanup. The independent exact-device getter then returned mode 7/value 0 on both thermal channels.

After the successful mode-7 query, Synapse relaunched showing HyperBoost. This demonstrates that the active state survived abrupt loss of the Synapse application long enough for independent readback; it does not prove persistence across reboot or power loss.
After the operator explicitly selected Balanced, Synapse was again force-terminated before normal shutdown cleanup. The independent getter returned mode 0/value 0 on both thermal channels.

During the paired restored state, the cooling pad was in Smart Fan Curve Balanced and the 0D/81 getter returned raw 2C. The byte has no assigned target or mode meaning, and Synapse exposes no measured fan-speed readback.

limitations: The Synapse application was deliberately force-terminated after each operator-confirmed state so normal shutdown cleanup could not replace the active state before the read-only getter. This was a bounded developer capture, not a production control mechanism.
The two Razer helper services and OpenBlade service were temporarily stopped only for the exact read-only query and were confirmed running afterward. Synapse was relaunched after each query.

The readback proves exact-device mode 7/value 0 while HyperBoost is active and mode 0/value 0 while Balanced is active. It does not independently validate any OpenBlade setter, power-limit effect, thermal safety behavior, or mode transition.
The filter-mediated path used by Synapse for the active mode-7 setter remains unresolved at the physical USB boundary.
Cooling-pad presence was not spoofed or removed. Pad-less HyperBoost activation remains untested and unsupported.

The cooling-pad 0D/81 byte is opaque and is neither configured-target nor measured-RPM readback. The candidate current-speed getter failed protocol validation and Synapse exposes no fan-speed readback.
The raw transcripts, process inventory, and Synapse logs remain local and uncommitted. The committed evidence contains no device serial, user path, or raw process inventory.

productionAdmission.reason: Active HyperBoost readback is confirmed on the exact model and BIOS, but no OpenBlade setter has been applied, read back, and restored; pad-presence eligibility and pad-less safety are also unvalidated.

notes: The read-only query required the exact host, exact HID collection, inactive Synapse controller processes, and inactive OpenBlade service.
The operator restored the final baseline to laptop Balanced and cooling-pad Auto fans.
OpenBlade, Synapse, Razer Game Manager Service 3, and Razer Elevation Service were running after cleanup; USBPcap was not running.
